segments.sn51.11:1.2: “Pubbeva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi –
segments.sn51.11:1.3: ‘ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo iddhipādabhāvanāyā’ti?
segments.sn51.11:1.5: ‘idha bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti – iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati, na ca atippaggahito bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati.
segments.sn51.11:1.7: Pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure;
segments.sn51.11:1.9: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho;
segments.sn51.11:1.10: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
segments.sn51.11:1.11: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti’”.
segments.sn51.11:2.1: “Vīriyasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti – iti me vīriyaṃ na ca atilīnaṃ bhavissati, na ca atippaggahitaṃ bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ bhavissati.
segments.sn51.11:2.3: Pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure;
segments.sn51.11:2.5: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho;
segments.sn51.11:2.6: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
segments.sn51.11:2.7: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn51.11:3.1: “Cittasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti – iti me cittaṃ na ca atilīnaṃ bhavissati, na ca atippaggahitaṃ bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ bhavissati.
segments.sn51.11:3.3: Pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure;
segments.sn51.11:3.5: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho;
segments.sn51.11:3.6: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
segments.sn51.11:3.7: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn51.11:4.1: “Vīmaṃsāsamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti – iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati, na ca atippaggahitā bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati.
segments.sn51.11:4.3: Pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure;
segments.sn51.11:4.5: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho;
segments.sn51.11:4.6: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
segments.sn51.11:4.7: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn51.11:5.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhu, catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti – ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti; āvibhāvaṃ, tirobhāvaṃ; tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse; pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti, seyyathāpi udake; udakepi abhijjamāne [abhijjamāno (sī. pī. ka.)] gacchati, seyyathāpi pathaviyaṃ; ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo; imepi candimasūriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati [parāmasati (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] parimajjati; yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
segments.sn51.11:6.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhu, catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti – dibbe ca mānuse ca, dūre santike cāti.
segments.sn51.11:7.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhu, catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti.
segments.sn51.11:8.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhu, catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ – ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattālīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe – ‘amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ [uppādiṃ (sī.)]; tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. Iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
segments.sn51.11:9.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho bhikkhu, catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti – ‘ime vata, bhonto, sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā; te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. Ime vā pana, bhonto, sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā; te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. Iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
segments.sn51.11:10.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhu, catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.

lines: 823-824. Dutiyavaggassa paṭhame na ca atilīnotiādīni parato āvi bhavissanti.
Imasmiṃ sutte chaabhiññāpādakā iddhipādā kathitā, tathā dutiye ca.
Yathā paṭhamasutte, tathā dutiyatatiyasuttesupi ca chaabhiññāpādakā iddhipādā kathitāti attho.
